SEEKING WORK | Lima, Peru (UTC-5, same hours as US Eastern) | Remote

Location: Lima, Peru

Remote: Yes, remote only

Willing to relocate: No

Technologies: n8n, Claude Code / Claude Agent SDK, Gemini, RAG with pgvector, Next.js, React, TypeScript, Supabase (Postgres, RLS), Python, Docker, Linux

Résumé/CV: on request

Email: astieman@outlook.com

LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/sjaack-tieman-72a242224

I'm the in-house AI and automation specialist at a food company group in Lima (5 companies, about 80 employees). I sit down with department heads, work out what is worth automating, build it and keep it running in production. Some of what runs today:

- n8n chatbots on Messenger and Instagram for customer service and recruitment: close to 50,000 messages handled, 600+ job candidates screened by an AI-led interview

- 35+ n8n workflows in production (webhooks, sub-workflows, RAG knowledge-base sync, lead capture)

- The company ERP: about 80 employees clock in through its kiosk every day

- An offline-first delivery app for the drivers, around 2,000 deliveries a month

- The whole production server, run by me: self-hosted Supabase, n8n, Docker, Caddy, nightly backups

Before this I ran production operations in the Netherlands for ten years, so I start with the process, not the code.

Looking for contract or part-time work: n8n and AI-agent automations, internal tools on Next.js and Supabase, or fixing workflows that broke. Dutch native, fluent English, basic Spanish.
